C1329.title: IBM Report Reveals Shadow AI Increases Data Breach Costs
C1329.summary: IBM's report indicates that enterprises failing to effectively protect their AI tools often suffer broader data breaches. Unauthorized use of AI tools raises the average cost of a data breach, causing losses exceeding $650,000 for businesses, highlighting the severe consequences of lacking an AI governance framework.

references.title: 'Shadow AI' increases cost of data breaches, report finds
